stories.title: Capture contact preferences
stories.description:
As a customer I want to choose how the company contacts me.

Figma Design Link: Contact preferences
stories.acceptanceCriteria:
• Scenario 1: the page shows four Yes/No toggles (email, SMS, phone, post) per the design
  • Scenario 2: Save persists the choices and shows a success toast
  • Scenario 3: leaving the page without saving shows a discard warning

stories.title: Address lookup with map
stories.description:
As a customer I want to find my address by dropping a pin on a map.

Figma Design Link: Address lookup
stories.acceptanceCriteria:
• Scenario 1: the page shows the map plus 9 address fields per the design
  • Scenario 2: dropping a pin autofills district, street and postal code from the maps API
  • Scenario 3: a pin outside the service area shows the coverage error in EN and AR
  • Scenario 4: manual entry validates every field (required, format, max length)
  • Scenario 5: the maps API timing out shows the retry banner without losing entered data
  • Scenario 6: Confirm persists the address and moves the customer forward
  • Edge cases: pin on a border, RTL rendering of street names, 20+ translated strings

stories.title: Notification settings
stories.description: As a customer I want to control how often I am notified.
stories.acceptanceCriteria:
• Scenario 1: the page shows the frequency dropdown (Instant, Daily, Weekly, Off) and a quiet-hours range per the design
  • Scenario 2: quiet-hours start must be before end - inline error otherwise
  • Scenario 3: Save persists and confirms with a toast
  • Scenario 4: Off disables and greys out quiet hours
